hooks.text: 摆放并旋转兵种，让每个单位的专属能力在阵型中生效
hooks.excerpt: Place and rotate them to use their specific talents to the fullest.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 在商店、精英恶魔与路线风险间抉择，让每次远征形成不同机会
hooks.excerpt: Choose your commander, units, and items, and make decisions about the path you take. Is it worth stopping at this strange shop , or do you feel ready to fight an elite demon ? Every run presents new opportunities to experiment with powerful combinations , ensuring no two adventures are ever the same.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 围绕附魔、恶魔灵魂、兵力与经济寻找自己的军团策略
hooks.excerpt: Upgrade your troops, swarm your enemies, search for the perfect ally or focus on your economy. It’s up to you to find the best way to use the enchants , troops and demonic souls at your disposal.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
